title: P3 timing helper input, version 1
description: Supplied sentence-end timing annotations, not translation truth or calibrated-clock evidence.
$comment: Run p3_evidence.py timing after schema validation. The helper additionally rejects duplicate JSON object keys, duplicate unit_id values, nonfinite parsed numbers (including overflow), and source_start_ms > source_end_ms. Standard JSON numbers exclude NaN/Infinity. A single calibrated clock and correct unit matching are upstream obligations that neither schema nor helper verifies. JSON Schema integer is mathematical: it may accept a lexical 1.0; the helper requires Python int for schema_version. No result grants release eligibility.

stable_correct_ms.description: Null means missing. A supplied timestamp may precede source_end_ms; negative derived latency must not be clamped.
